sections.heading: How To Use?
sections.text:
1. Hold the bottle close to your scalp and spray 5–6 strokes evenly across the affected areas.

2. Gently massage in circular motions using your fingertips to help improve absorption and stimulate the scalp.

3. Leave it overnight for best results.

4. Rinse off with water the next morning (use shampoo in case of any scalp dirt or build-up).

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Ayurvedic Phus Phus Rice Hair MistIndia’s Most Viral Haircare Mist — Trusted by 5M+ Users

Meet India’s First Fermentation-Based Rice Hair Mist — the iconic Phus Phus Mist that has taken the nation by storm. Formulated after 3+ years of research and proven successful for 5 years, each bottle undergoes 30+ days of natural fermentation, allowing the actives to enrich, strengthen, and deeply nourish your scalp for faster and healthier hair growth.

Inspired by ancient traditions, this breakthrough formula elevates the age-old secret of fermented rice water with the power of Coffee, Bhringraj, and Amla — renowned Ayurvedic ingredients that support regrowth, strengthen roots, and improve overall scalp vitality.

Lightweight and non-sticky, this leave-in overnight mist absorbs instantly and It effectively targets excessive hair fall, thinning and weak strands, poor hair density, slow hair growth, and weak roots, delivering comprehensive nourishment for stronger, fuller, and healthier hair over time.

Loved across India and trusted with 20+ million units sold, Nuskhe by Paras’ Ayurvedic Phus Phus Rice Mist has become a go-to ritual for real, visible transformation within weeks of consistent use. No oiliness, no heaviness — just effortless, everyday haircare with powerful results.

 ✨ Achievements• 3+ Years of Formulation Research• 20+ Million Units Sold• 5 Years of Proven Success• India’s Most Re-Purchased Hair Growth Formula

Experience the revolution in Ayurvedic haircare — simple, effective, and truly transformative. Your strongest, fullest hair starts here.

sections.heading: FAQ
sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Q1. How soon will I start seeing results?

Most users notice reduced hair fall in 2–3 weeks, and visible regrowth in 4–8 weeks with daily use.

Q2. Can I replace hair oil with this mist?

Yes — this mist is lightweight and non-sticky, providing nourishment without oiliness.

Q3. Is it safe for daily use?

Absolutely. It is Ayurvedic, gentle, and scalp-friendly for everyday overnight use.

Q4. Do I need to rinse it in the morning?

Yes — ideally rinse with plain water the next morning. Use shampoo only if needed or if you see scalp dirt or any build-up.

Q5. Does it work on chemically treated or colored hair?

Yes — the formula is safe for colored, keratin-treated, and chemically processed hair.

Q6. Can it help with thinning and bald patches?

Consistent use stimulates roots and may help reduce thinning & support regrowth, especially when paired with gentle scalp massage.
